item.title: Tiny Air-To-Air Missile In Development For Stealthy U.S. Navy Combat Aircraft
item.summary: The big AIM-424 long-range air-to-air missile has grabbed headlines, but the Navy is also pursuing a new weapon for the exact opposite use case. The post Tiny Air-To-Air Missile In Development For Stealthy U.S. Navy Combat Aircraft appeared first on TWZ .
